activity_summary: You looked at the orchard bench in the morning shade. The inkhorn was in the plank, with two quills, and last night's sheets were under the stone. You did not sit down to them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood at the bench and did not sit down to them.

entities.name: the orchard scene
entities.context: Mentioned in The bench in apple-shade

facets.activity: Looked at last night's sheets on the bench
